p1.title: Backend migrations and E2E activation are unverified
p1.reason: Migration artifacts exist but local/remote apply and authenticated production-like E2E were intentionally not run.
p1.nextAction: Apply migrations in an isolated staging project, run RLS/auth/ownership E2E, then explicitly enable flags.

p1.title: Transaction surfaces have no production inventory
p1.reason: Charter records, Market listings, and Community posts are all zero or local-only.
p1.nextAction: Ingest and review authoritative supply/content before claiming transactional availability.

p1.title: SEO indexing policy is incomplete
p1.reason: Manifest, icons, and service worker exist, but repository audit found no robots, sitemap, or route-level canonical/noindex policy.
p1.nextAction: Define and verify robots/sitemap/canonical and private-route noindex contracts.

p2.title: Security header policy is not declared in Next config
p2.reason: No CSP, frame, referrer, permissions, or HSTS policy is configured in repository code.
p2.nextAction: Audit host defaults and add a tested minimal policy.

p2.title: PWA installation and browser release matrix could not be rerun
p2.reason: In-app browser returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT for localhost, so install/update behavior and responsive verification could not be observed in this audit.
p2.nextAction: Run PWA install/update plus 390x844 and 1280x900 matrix in a supported browser runner.
